old: The Board of Forestry approved the five foot ember resistant zone rule on August 19, 2026 and filed it on August 28. No source confirmed its approval or an effective date by the compile date. Treat it as pending.'
new: The Board of Forestry approved the final draft of the five foot ember resistant zone rule on August 19, 2026, and a law firm alert says it was sent to the Office of Administrative Law on August 28. No source confirmed that office\'s approval or an effective date by the compile date. Treat it as pending.'
